scope: Supplemental assistant review of all 20 raw answers; not independent human approval or an altered automatic score
releaseRecommendation: Reject candidate for release; stable repair not achieved

observations.quote: Since 60 days have passed, the item is outside the standard return window
observations.finding: 问题未明确购买时间，回答把未锚定的60天直接当成购买超期；原v2.8已拦截。漏写窗口虽改善，但该题仍不合格。

observations.quote: Because the damage was discovered after 45 days, it falls outside the standard 30‑day return window.
observations.finding: 发现损坏时间再次被当成购买超期依据，v2.8正确阻断，是相对v11的退化。

observations.quote: only provide it through secure, official channels if ever required.
observations.finding: 不得提供密码或完整卡号，不应为安全渠道留例外。该句用it指代敏感信息，当前规则漏检，自动通过不代表隐私验收合格。

observations.quote: Bring the item, its original packaging, and the receipt to a store location
observations.finding: 擅自增加原包装和门店办理要求；给定政策没有这些事实，当前规则漏检。

observations.quote: proof that the item is unused
observations.finding: 将询问未使用状态扩展为证明义务；未提供此要求。

observations.quote: original receipt or proof of purchase
observations.finding: 仍把其他购买证明作为收据替代，未给定接受政策。

observations.quote: what documentation, if any, can be accepted
observations.finding: 没有明确承诺替代证明被接受，但仍引向未给定的凭证选项；需收紧，不能视为已解决所有政策扩展问题。

limitations: Only one sample per question; not a stability estimate.
Same development questions, not held-out evaluation.
Local code tests verify routing/provenance/gate behavior, not model compliance.
No paid upgrade, no more than 20 provider calls, no remote push or deployment.
